in_arabic.name: بحرالدین
in_arabic.meaning: بحر و دین کا مؤلف، دینی بحر کا مالک
in_arabic.long_meaning: اس نام کا مطلب ہے بحر یعنی سمندر اور دین یعنی مذہب کا مالک یا مؤلف۔ یہ نام اسلامی علماء اور صوفیاء میں بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ دینی علوم اور تصوف کی وسیع و عریض بحر کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: بحرالدین
in_urdu.meaning: دین کا سمندر، مذہب کی بحر کا مالک
in_urdu.long_meaning: بحرالدین کا مطلب ہے دین کی بحر کا مالک یا دینی بحر کا حامل۔ یہ نام مذہبی اور روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر علم دین اور تصوف کے شائقین میں۔

in_hindi.name: बह्रदीन
in_hindi.meaning: धर्म का सागर, धार्मिक ज्ञान का समुद्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: बह्रदीन नाम का अर्थ है धर्म का सागर या धार्मिक ज्ञान का समुद्र। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में विद्वानों और सूफियों के बीच लोकप्रिय है, जो धार्मिक ज्ञान और आध्यात्मिकता की गहराई को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: بحرالدین
in_pashto.meaning: د دین سمندر، د مذهب بحر مالک
in_pashto.long_meaning: بحرالدین د دین سمندر یا د مذهب بحر مالک معنی لري. دا نوم د مذهبي او روحاني پوهې د يو حامل يا ديني علومو د سمندر د مالک په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Bahradin
in_english.meaning: Ocean of religion, owner of the sea of knowledge
in_english.long_meaning: Bahradin is an Arabic name meaning 'ocean of religion' or 'owner of the sea of knowledge'. It is derived from 'bahr' (بحر) meaning 'sea' or 'ocean' and 'din' (دين) meaning 'religion' or 'faith'. This name signifies a person who possesses deep knowledge and understanding of religious sciences and spirituality. Historically, it has been used among Islamic scholars and Sufis to denote someone who has mastery over the vast ocean of religious knowledge.

Its meaning, "Fortunate, Radiant," is a reminder of the blessings and good fortune we have been granted as Muslims. It emphasizes the importance of looking at life with a positive attitude and appreciating the blessings of Allah (God) in our daily lives. Moreover, the name Bahradin reflects the rich cultural heritage of the Islamic civilization and is a source of pride for many Muslims.
data.spiritual_significance: Bahradin carries a deeper spiritual significance as it reminds us of the light of Allah that shines upon us. The name intends us to radiate with the inner light of faith, wisdom, and compassion. As the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "O Allah, make this light (of Iman) complete in my chest and radical in my heart." (Bukhari and Muslim). The name serves as a constant reminder to seek the light of Allah and to strive to be a source of light and guidance for others. It is a call to remain fortunate by staying connected to Allah and living a life that honors His commands. Overall, Bahradin is a reminder of the blessings of Allah and a call to embody the inner light of faith and good character.
